newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex market trades $3.79 bln in February.
newsitem.headline: China forex market trades $3.79 bln in February.

text.p: The China Foreign Exchange Trade System, an interbank market based in Shanghai, traded $3.79 billion in February, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday, quoting exchange figures.
The turnover was a sharp fall against $6.22 billion in January mainly because of the long Chinese Lunar new year holiday in early February.
U.S. dollar transactions accounted for $3.5 billion, and other transactions included HK$1.885 billion and 5.52 billion Japanese yen.
